description: This Java class 'ConceptDatatypeEditor' extends 'OpenmrsPropertyEditor' to serialize and deserialize 'ConceptDatatype' objects for web forms or other mediums, including retrieval by ID and UUID.

classes.name: ConceptDatatypeEditor
classes.description: A property editor for converting between ConceptDatatype objects and their String representations, supporting retrieval by ID and UUID.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptDatatype object using its integer ID via the ConceptService.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptDatatype object using its UUID string via the ConceptService.
